channel: Legislative petition framed as a public-health measure (the water device)
why_tested: To obtain banking capacity in a legislature that would not grant a bank charter
cost_or_effort: Political: the clause provoked an effort to defeat the bill
result: The franchise was obtained and exercised the same year
repeatability: Repeatable in the short run: the Chemical line used the inverse device in 1823
notes: The origin stage of this company is a CHANNEL history: access to a licence rather than access to customers.

channel: Legislative petition framed as a manufacturing measure with an express anti-banking clause
why_tested: Same problem in a hostile session after 1824's public suspicion of banks
result: Both purposes granted; manufacture abandoned; banking kept
notes: The only case where the corpus prints the vote count of the founding act.

why_tested: To tell the market where and when to transact
cost_or_effort: UNKNOWN - no advertising cost prints anywhere in the window
result: A public counter with named hours and a named cashier, attested only by the bank's own later reprint
repeatability: The practice continued for a century in this carrier's telling
notes: No conversion of any kind is measurable; §S.4.

result: A product line launched and praised by a state medical society committee
repeatability: The line was discontinued as a priority by 1832
notes: The only third-party attestation of a product in the window (D. R. Beck; Lawrence Hull; Dan'l Ayres).

channel: Paid-for publicity through a celebrity stunt (specie redemption to ladies)
why_tested: To hold note confidence during a general suspension
cost_or_effort: The editor's own specie, 5 dollars per person
result: Note preference asserted by the same voice
repeatability: One event; the same editor repeats the device in 1839
notes: The only in-period customer-facing trust experiment the corpus holds.

channel: Printed dividend notices in the daily papers
date_tested: 1848-12-27 (the day after the board resolved it)
why_tested: To announce the return to shareholders and the market
repeatability: Institutionalised as clockwork regularity in the carrier's words
notes: Shareholder-facing communication as a repeatable channel.

channel: Standing advertisements in colonial trade press naming parent and correspondents
why_tested: To reach foreign-trade account holders and signal parentage across the Pacific
result: Two Chase/parent namings and a possible Morgan naming survive in the layers
repeatability: Recurring: the same Chase copy prints in successive issues
confidence: Medium (that it ran) / Low (what it sold)
notes: The namings are ADVERT and TABLE namings on Chinese-colonial pages - not New York reporting (U.011; §Q.4).

channel: First-party printed submission to a Congressional sub-committee
why_tested: To rebut the concentration-and-control framing on the record
result: The letter survives as the sole first-party Morgan document
repeatability: Not a commercial channel; recorded because it is the only Morgan route the corpus holds
notes: Advocacy with no measurable commercial result (§N; §C.3).

why_tested: To publish research under the merged bank's name
repeatability: Repeatable series with further issues unmined
notes: Held for Stage 2; logged here because the harvest window treats it as in-window (U.003).
